evals.name: prisma-cardinality-offline
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-data

The convention home resolves and architecture_dir is docs/architecture. The repository has orders/schema.prisma and no database connection. User has many Post. Post.authorId is a required foreign key to User.id. diagram_dialect.data is unset. The run is non-interactive.
evals.expected_output: collect-data.sh writes data-model.json from the Prisma schema. The source tier is model / prisma. render-data.sh writes an erDiagram whose cardinality is User ||--o{ Post. Column names such as title are absent. The report names the tier.
expectations: Runs collect-data.sh and render-data.sh rather than drawing the diagram by hand
Does not open a database connection
The artifact says the source tier is model (prisma)
The mermaid relationship is User ||--o{ Post
title does not appear, because --include-columns was not passed
The dialect is mermaid by default and the report says so

evals.name: several-modules-refuse
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-data

orders/schema.prisma declares Order and billing/schema.prisma declares Invoice. No --scope argument. The run is non-interactive.
evals.expected_output: render-data.sh exits 3. data-model.md lists orders and billing, says scope-unresolved, and contains no erDiagram.
expectations: Does not draw both modules into one diagram
Names orders and billing as the choices
The artifact states the refusal
Stops after the refusal in a non-interactive run

evals.name: migration-mismatch-is-reported
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-data --scope shop

shop/schema.prisma declares Post.authorId as required. shop/prisma/migrations/20240101000000_init/migration.sql declares authorId without NOT NULL. Both are tracked.
evals.expected_output: The diagram follows the Prisma schema (required, ||--o{). The artifact contains an optionality mismatch and does not drop either declaration.
expectations: source_tool is prisma
The mismatch kind is optionality
The drawn cardinality stays ||--o{
The SQL declaration is not silently treated as the diagram

evals.name: django-and-live-refuse
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-data --live

The repository has a Prisma schema and also app/models.py with a Django model. The operator passed --live.
evals.expected_output: The record reason is live-connection-requested. No diagram is drawn and the Prisma file is not read. A separate run without --live, facing Prisma plus Django, refuses with partial-read and still draws nothing.
expectations: Does not open a connection when --live is passed
Does not fall through to the offline schema on --live
A Django model beside Prisma is a partial-read refusal, not a Prisma-only diagram
The artifact names the reason

evals.name: columns-and-dbml
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-data --include-columns --dialect dbml

The team authoring-formats doc is absent. The operator passed --dialect dbml and --include-columns. The schema has Post.title.
evals.expected_output: The dialect layer is the argument, not the default. data-model.dbml contains the title column and a Ref for the foreign key.
expectations: Passes --include-columns and --dialect dbml to render-data.sh
Reports the dialect layer as argument
title appears in data-model.dbml
The foreign key is a DBML Ref
